answer:
I don't know of a promptfoo command that exports an evaluation to Parquet. The retrieved documents don't mention Parquet.

The documented export command writes JSON:

"Export an eval record to JSON format. To export the most recent, use `latest`." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]

The same page lists only one option for it:

"`-o, --output <filepath>` | File to write. Writes to stdout by default." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]

`promptfoo eval --output` also supports XML, as the outputs doc shows:

"promptfoo eval --output results.xml" [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/outputs.md]

If you need Parquet, you would have to convert the JSON export yourself. To check whether a native option exists, see the output formats page.
